rows.en: Don't tell me... Belial and the others were...!?
Don't tell me... Belial and the others were...!?
Don't tell me... Belial and the others were...!?
Don't tell me... Belial and the others were...!?
Don't tell me... Belial and the others were...!?
Don't tell me... Belial and the others were...!?
Everything was under my control, down to the subconscious level.
As these fellows act just as they did in their original worlds, committing every evil they can,
It keeps on growing, and becomes the source of power for absorbing even more phenomena.
Even at this very moment it keeps growing, and before long it will swallow every world whole,
and a reign of despair and terror will begin!!
Like hell... we'll let you do that!!
We'll never... let you do that!!
We'll never... let you do thaaat!!
We won't let that happen... We'll never let you do that!!!
Like hell... we'll let you do that!!
We'll never... let you do that!!
We'll never... let you do that!!
There's no way... I'd ever let you pull that off!!
We'll never... let you do that!!
We'll never... let you do that!!
I will never... allow such a thing!!!
We'll never... let you do that!!
We'll never... let you do that!!
We'll never... let you do that!!
We'll never... let you do that!!
You are all destined to perish here!! Fufufufu, hahahahahahahahahaha!!!
...!! So you've shown yourself!! Devil Gundam!!
So you were still alive after all...!!
This is the Devil Gundam's core, and its final form. It has merged with me and evolved.
With this ultimate power, I shall bury you all!!!
You seem more capable than I thought... To think you would make me get serious...
Just then, the "Memory Memory" and three Core Medals came flying in from out of nowhere.

notes.note: Speakers verified against 0736.bla. Block #82-96 = TextIdOffset+81+R, R from the second Pt_Chara_Check chain (ids 15,5,10,14,4,9,13,3,8,12,2,7,11,1,6 = Zero, OOO, 00, Mebius, W, Wing Zero, Taro, Den-O, God Gundam, Seven, Black RX, Zeta, Ultraman, Rider 1, Nu). #91-96 = Seven, Black RX, Zeta, Ultraman, Rider 1, Nu; all identical. Reacts to Regis saying it 'made use of' the kaiju, kaijin and MS (story_172 #81); trailing 'were...' keeps the source's unfinished suspicion.
Regis (CHARA_NAME 228), TextIdOffset+96. 'Everything' = all the villains' doings, answering the party's suspicion about Belial and the others.
Block #100-114 = TextIdOffset+99+R, same chain order (#100 Zero ... #114 Nu). All identical.

Regis, one sentence cut over #116-120; English cut at matching points (#116 ends with a comma, #117 completes the clause, #119 comma, #120 lowercase continuation). 'These fellows' = the villains Regis used (Belial etc.).
Phenomena: same word Regis used in story_172 #80 for what it absorbs from the heroes' worlds. Subject 'It' = the Minus Energy.

Block #121-135 = TextIdOffset+120+R, same chain order. Wording confirms it: #121 Zero and #125 W rough (Like hell...), #123 00 drawn-out shout, #124 Mebius doubled vow, #128 Den-O = Momotaros (explicit 'this I' and rough negation), #131 Black RX ('I will not allow it' style). Unmarked subject rendered 'we' (leader speaks for the team, as in story_171); #128 and #131 have explicit first person 'I'.
Regis, TextIdOffset+136. Laugh kept as Fufufu/hahaha, matching Regis's laugh shape in story_172 #18.
Block #144-158 = TextIdOffset+143+R, same chain order. Devil Gundam Final Form (CHARA_PIC 229) appears. #151 = Den-O (Momotaros, rough 'you'), #157 = Rider 1 ('so you've appeared').

NOT played by the script: no MessWinSet points at entry 159 (Regis's TextIdOffset+159/+160 show #160/#161). Orphan leader line, speaker unknown (wording suggests someone who fought the Devil Gundam before, likely God Gundam). Translated neutrally.
Regis, TextIdOffset+159 and +160. 'It' = the Devil Gundam core/final form that fused with Regis.
Regis, TextIdOffset+162, after the battle. Grunt rendered like earlier 'Gwoh...' groans, with the doubled vowel.

Block #164-178 = TextIdOffset+163+R. A third Pt_Chara_Check chain runs just before it (God Gundam, Zeta, Nu, 00, Wing Zero, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, Zero, Mebius, Den-O, Black RX, Rider 1, OOO, W); all 15 lines identical, so order does not matter. 'it' = Regis fused with the Devil Gundam (glossary g n). Subject 'we' restored.
Narration after CharaNameOut (TextIdOffset+184). Memory Memory in double quotes per glossary.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified against 0736.bla: leader blocks follow the second Pt_Chara_Check chain (Zero, OOO, 00, Mebius, W, Wing Zero, Taro, Den-O, God Gundam, Seven, Black RX, Zeta, Ultraman, Rider 1, Nu); #164-178 follow a third chain but are identical. #159 is never played (orphan leader line, speaker unknown). Unmarked subjects in #121-135 rendered 'we'. No new names or terms.
